aiDrawer.intro: Automated DAST is Appknox's AI-powered dynamic testing engine. Autonomous AI agents explore your uploaded application on a real device — planning and executing interactions, discovering screens and user flows, and identifying security issues the way a real user would encounter them. Every finding is backed by observed app behavior and screenshots captured during the scan.
aiDrawer.q1Body: The agents interact only with the application package uploaded to Appknox, running on an isolated test device. They can view app screens and perform UI interactions such as taps, swipes, and text input to explore the application. The agents do not have access to your production environments, user data, source code repositories, internal systems, or any assets beyond the uploaded application and its associated scan data.
aiDrawer.q1Title: 1. What data do AI agents have access to during an Automated DAST scan?
aiDrawer.q2Body: Automated DAST is designed with strict security boundaries and controls:
aiDrawer.q2List1: We use enterprise-grade LLM services with appropriate security and data protection controls.
aiDrawer.q2List2: Agents operate within controlled, isolated device environments that are restricted to the specific application under test.
aiDrawer.q2List3: Agent access is limited to the specific exploration task being performed, with only the required context provided.
aiDrawer.q2List4: Agents are restricted from making modifications to your applications, systems, or scan records.
aiDrawer.q2List5: Agent decisions, reasoning steps, and outputs are securely logged for auditability.
aiDrawer.q2List6: The Appknox platform undergoes regular independent third-party security assessments, and as part of those assessments, our agentic implementations are also assessed. Any corrective measures, if needed, are also implemented.
aiDrawer.q2Title: 2. How does Appknox ensure that the AI agents handle my application and scan data securely?
aiDrawer.q3Body: Automated DAST is built around evidence-based testing:
aiDrawer.q3List1: Findings are grounded in what the agents actually observe — screens visited and actions performed during the scan.
aiDrawer.q3List2: Screenshots and exploration artifacts are recorded for every discovered screen, and the complete navigation graph is available for your review.
aiDrawer.q3List3: Deterministic analysis techniques are used wherever applicable to complement AI-driven exploration and improve reliability.
aiDrawer.q3List4: Scan coverage is reported transparently, so you can see exactly which screens and flows were exercised before relying on the results.
aiDrawer.q3Title: 3. How does Automated DAST reduce the risk of inaccurate or hallucinated results?

fileDetailsDrawer.intro: KnoxIQ is Appknox's AI-powered triage layer that evaluates detected vulnerabilities, determines exploit likelihood, and generates contextual remediation guidance. It helps security and development teams prioritize vulnerabilities that matter most and accelerate remediation.
fileDetailsDrawer.q1Body: KnoxIQ agents have read-only access to the uploaded application package and the security scan results generated within Appknox. The agents do not have access to your production environments, user data, source code repositories, internal systems, or any assets beyond the uploaded application and its associated scan data.
fileDetailsDrawer.q1Title: 1. What data do AI agents have access to with respect to applications uploaded on Appknox?
fileDetailsDrawer.q2Body: KnoxIQ is designed with strict security boundaries and controls:
fileDetailsDrawer.q2List1: We use enterprise-grade LLM services with appropriate security and data protection controls.
fileDetailsDrawer.q2List2: Agent access is limited to the specific analysis task being performed, with only the required read-only context provided.
fileDetailsDrawer.q2List3: Agents operate within controlled environments and are restricted from making modifications to your applications, systems, or scan records.
fileDetailsDrawer.q2List4: Agent decisions, reasoning steps, and outputs are securely logged for auditability.
fileDetailsDrawer.q2List5: KnoxIQ undergoes adversarial AI security assessments aligned with the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, and identified risks are remediated as part of our security process.
fileDetailsDrawer.q2List6: The Appknox platform undergoes regular independent third-party security assessments, and identified security findings are prioritized and addressed by our engineering teams.
fileDetailsDrawer.q2Title: 2. How does KnoxIQ ensure that agents handle my application and scan data securely?
fileDetailsDrawer.q3Body: KnoxIQ is built around evidence-based analysis:
fileDetailsDrawer.q3List1: Agent conclusions are grounded in evidence extracted from the uploaded application and Appknox scan results. Unsupported assumptions or speculation are restricted.
fileDetailsDrawer.q3List2: A dedicated verification layer reviews generated results to validate evidence quality and identify potential gaps before presenting conclusions.
fileDetailsDrawer.q3List3: Every KnoxIQ assessment includes a confidence level, with guardrails designed to reduce confidence when supporting evidence is limited or incomplete.
fileDetailsDrawer.q3List4: Deterministic analysis techniques are used wherever applicable to complement AI-driven reasoning and improve reliability.
fileDetailsDrawer.q3Title: 3. How does KnoxIQ reduce the risk of inaccurate or hallucinated results?

piiAiDrawer.aiDataQ1Desc: Our AI model accesses the data residing in the application binary like java class files, layout, resource or any assets bundled in the application. Along with that, any data present in the API requests which can have username, password, account numbers etc.
piiAiDrawer.aiDataQ2Desc: Data is funneled into our ML agents and analyzed based on the type of data and where it belongs to. Multiple post processing layers are also present for improvising accuracy. For ex: We use Luln's algorithm over 16 digit numbers to verify it could be credit/debit card details or not.
piiAiDrawer.aiDataQ3: How is my data secured from threats?
piiAiDrawer.aiDataQ3Desc:
Any PII's that we may flag as a part of this analysis will be available in the UI for only a short span of time, after which the PII data will be masked. All PII findings are stored in an encrypted manner within our database.
We also run security audits on our AI models, from a third party vendor, at regular intervals of time. We immediately address the findings (if any) that may arise out of this exercise.

reportModule.aiDataProtection: How is your data protected from security threats?

aiDataProtectionList.item1: The AI cannot access your data, unless identifiers like namespace, file ID, or username are explicitly included in your prompt. Even in such cases, it can only use this info to hand over to the data processing layer to get the relevant details. The LLM doesn't have any access to the database containing your data.
aiDataProtectionList.item2: It has no knowledge of internal logic or database structure beyond the provided blueprint.
aiDataProtectionList.item3: Our database access is tightly controlled, and the system architecture ensures that only predefined, read-only queries are allowed through the AI layer.
